newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Votorantim 1996 net falls. [CORRECTED 15:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Votorantim 1996 net falls. [CORRECTED 15:30 GMT]

text.p: Brazilian industrial group S.A. Industrias Votorantim, which is leading a consortium that plans to bid Tuesday at the privatization auction of state mining firm Cia Vale do Rio Doce, published the following 1996 financial results.
(Corrects net figures from 203.1 million vs 107.3 million)
NOTE: All figures in Brazilian reais, not adjusted for inflation.
The Votorantim group, which reported a net worth of 5.92 billion reais last year compared with 5.81 billion reais in 1995, has interests in cement, energy, mining, paper and steel.
Assets totalled 8.24 billion reais in 1996 vs 7.52 billion reais.
Among Votorantim's holdings is Votorantim Celulose e Papel S.A., which is listed on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange. Its published results did not provide a break-down of earnings for subsidiaries.

Votorantim heads a group planning to bid Tuesday on a 40-45 percent stake in CVRD. The government set a $3 billion base price for the stake but analysts said it is likely to receive a premium of 20 percent to 30 percent above that figure.
